intro: A portable transport container provided by the goblin entrepreneur Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. Pierced with air vents, it safely houses a trained Snufflenose Gopher used to track down subterranean culinary delicacies within the quilboar stronghold of Razorfen Kraul.

p: To acquire rare Blueleaf Tubers from the thorny depths of Razorfen Kraul, goblin merchant Mebok Mizzyrix relies on trained Snufflenose Gophers rather than blind digging. Because gophers cannot simply follow an adventurer across the dusty trails of the Barrens on foot, Mebok packs each critter into a well-ventilated wooden crate. Once brought into the humid, root-choked corridors of the quilboar lair, the crate is unlatched, allowing the beast within to follow its keen sense of smell toward buried tubers.
